data.long_meaning: The name Kaushik is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaushika' which means 'Intelligent, Brave, Wise'. This name is believed to be a combination of two words - 'Kaus' which means 'Intelligence' and 'Shik' which means 'Learning'. The name Kaushik carries the meaning “Intelligent, Brave, Wise” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi, Bengali. Parents who choose Kaushik usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, brave, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is believed that the name is associated with the deity 'Kaushik' or 'Lord Shiva', who is known for his intelligence, bravery, and wisdom. Kaushik is a name that embodies the qualities of a spiritual and wise being.
